# Commander precon decklists

Every preconstructed Commander deck listed by MTGJSON (deck type "Commander Deck"), 197 decks, oldest first. Data: MTGJSON 5.3.0+20261015 (fetched 2026-10-16), from Wizards' published decklists (each deck's source link is given).

**Card art.** Each row names the exact printing that comes in the box: set code, collector number, finish, artist and Scryfall ID. That pins the art without bundling it: the game shows it only through the opt-in Scryfall images (image URL from the Scryfall ID) or the player's own uploads, with the artist credited, as for every card (no art is shipped).

Card lists are paper printings; Collector's Edition decks are listed separately because their printings (and so their art and finishes) differ. Planechase planes and Archenemy schemes that come with a deck are listed under it but are not part of the 100 cards.
